manufacture: The LOD0 operating lever is reconstructed as one continuous swept metal body around a crescent centerline rather than six overlapping box segments. The cross-section uses broad manufactured faces connected by a small corner break so the silhouette and grazing highlight are produced by real geometry. This is a conservative die-cast/formed-hard-surface reconstruction, not identification of an exact historical lock product.
dimensionsThickness: The parent assembly retains the 34 mm nominal crescent centerline radius. The refinement uses a 130 degree sweep from -65 to +65 degrees, a 10 mm x 10 mm lever section and a 2 mm geometric corner break. Thirty-two arc rings resolve the LOD0 curve; these section dimensions are benchmark reconstruction assumptions and must be corrected if native-4K evidence makes the lever read overbuilt or undersized.
materialsFinish: The renderer continues to use the parent canonical aged sash-metal material MAT_AgedAluminum. It remains a metallic workflow surface with no emission or painted highlight. Albedo/roughness/normal microstructure represent subdued aged metal; geometric corner breaks alone create edge rolloff. The benchmark is dry and no wet-film layer is permitted.
installation: The refined mesh occupies exactly the parent CrescentLever renderer and asset path, preserving the existing pivot, base plate, receiver, fasteners, renderer identity, local transform and cause-based weathering metadata. It is prepared before the first formal reflection baseline so cubemap and still geometry cannot disagree merely because an old six-box cache was loaded.
interfacesGapsSeals: The curve rotates around the existing pivot and must preserve a visible mechanical relationship to the separate receiver while clearing meeting-stile metal, optical glass and glazing gasket geometry. The refinement may not enlarge into those interfaces, float away from the pivot, or hide penetration behind material shading.
orientationExposure: Vertical sheltered window hardware exposed to coherent midsummer Japanese daylight, sky fill, contact shadow and reflection-probe response. The crescent edge is specifically expected to reveal its physical curvature in oblique and grazing light; direct illumination and reflection direction must remain coherent with the scene sun.
aging: Aging remains inherited from the parent lever weathering metadata: localized hand/contact polish plus restrained sheltered oxidation/UV drift. No random rust field, damage narrative, bright edge paint or independent dirt decal is introduced by the curve refinement.
geometryVsMaterial: The 34 mm swept centerline, 130 degree silhouette, 10 mm section, 2 mm corner break, cap geometry and all LOD simplification are geometry. Fine extrusion/pitting, approximately 0.45 mm microstructure, oxidation, micro-scratches and localized contact polish remain material/normal response. Lighting and Fresnel are never baked into albedo.
weatheringCausality: No new stain layer is generated. The parent QualityBlockWeatheringSurface on CrescentLever remains authoritative: sheltered/recessed exposure drives grime and UV dulling, while the higher contact term is limited to the operating lever because it is handled. The refinement only changes manufactured form.
lookdevBrief: Front native-4K view: the crescent must read as one continuous metal operating lever with no six-piece stepping. 35-degree oblique: verify the 10 mm physical section, pivot seating and receiver clearance. Midsummer grazing view: highlight should roll continuously around the 2 mm corner break without a faceted staircase, chrome stripe or baked edge. 100-percent sash crop: inspect silhouette faceting, cap shape, glass/gasket intersection, UV-phase repetition and z-fighting. Temporal oblique motion: the smoother LOD0 does not waive the existing LOD1 transition; verify no visible pop or sub-pixel shimmer.

material.uvAging: Restrained oxidation/value/roughness drift; local hand contact may polish but cannot paint a highlight or override the geometric curve.
material.angularFresnelResponse: Aged metallic environment response strengthens naturally at grazing angle; the continuous swept mesh and 2 mm corner break should broaden highlight travel without behaving like chrome.
